blocks.text: # Proofpress X launch

**Status:** canonical draft
**Channel:** X
**Primary asset:** 18–22 second silent-first launch film
**Source of strategic truth:** `docs/internal/decision_strategy/PORTABLE_ARTIFACT_STRATEGY.md`
## Launch decision

The X launch should claim the category, then bind it immediately to the product
boundary. Lead with **the trust layer for multiplayer AI**, immediately followed
by **an open, agent-native ledger that travels with the artifact**. Scope
“trust” to a shared, checkable artifact ledger rather than identity,
authorization, access control, or cryptographically signed authorship.

“Multiplayer AI” is the launch entry point. The durable strategic category
remains agent-native knowledge work; the technical definition remains an open
protocol for versioned knowledge artifacts with verifiable provenance. Portable
handoff is the sharpest product proof: the ledger can travel with the file after
the live session ends.
## Canonical launch post

The main post carries the native launch film and deliberately contains no link.
Its only job is category recognition and a complete first impression during
muted autoplay. The repository and article belong in the immediate replies.

> Introducing Proofpress.
>
> The trust layer for multiplayer AI.
> An open, agent-native ledger that travels with the artifact.
>
> Humans and agents edit one file across sessions. The file moves; its decision trail does not.

Attach the launch film directly to this post. Do not add hashtags, launch emojis,
mentions, a request to repost, or a second call to action.
## Reply thread

The canonical first reply converts attention into a repository visit and a
five-minute product proof. Publish the vision article as Reply 2: it is valuable
for readers who want the larger argument, but must not compete with the
open-source call to action directly beneath the video.
### Reply 1 — open-source repository and demo

> Your team and agents hand off a file.
>
> The record of what changed, why it changed, and which paths were rejected should travel with it too.
>
> Proofpress is open source:
> https://github.com/chenmingtang830/proofpress
>
> Try the portable handoff demo in five minutes.
### Reply 2 — short founder vision note

> Git made code collaborative. Proofpress makes intelligence cumulative.
>
> The handoff is the wedge: an open ledger makes knowledge humans and agents can verify, inherit, and extend.
>
> Read the short note: [X Article URL]

Article source: `docs/internal/launch/vision-article.md`. Keep it a concise
vision note; do not repeat the product demo, installation flow, or FAQ already
served by the video and Reply 1.
## Video length

Use an 18–22 second film. The X asset has one job: introduce the category and
show that the artifact ledger survives a human-agent handoff. Stale-base
refusal, installation, and the full honesty boundary belong in follow-up
material rather than this first film.

The film must be understandable without narration. Music and sound design may
add rhythm, but the category, handoff problem, ledger, and portable outcome must
survive muted autoplay.
## Film script
### Beat 1 — introduce the category, 0:00–0:03
On-screen copy:

```text
INTRODUCING PROOFPRESS

THE TRUST LAYER
FOR MULTIPLAYER AI

AN OPEN, AGENT-NATIVE LEDGER
THAT TRAVELS WITH THE ARTIFACT
```

Visual: a restrained product-title reveal resolves into one `strategy.md`
artifact between a human workspace and an agent session. “Trust layer” should
feel infrastructural, not like security-theater metallic.
### Beat 2 — the handoff gap, 0:03–0:07
On-screen copy:

```text
THE FILE TRAVELS.
ITS DECISION TRAIL STAYS BEHIND.
```

Visual: the file moves from the first workspace to a second agent session. The
artifact stays solid while the accepted rationale, rejected direction, and
lineage remain visibly stranded in the first session.
### Beat 3 — reveal the ledger, 0:07–0:14
Show a real, simplified Proofpress ledger event:

```text
strategy.md  v1 → v2

edit · COMPETITIVE
move beyond orchestration to an artifact-native ledger

why · DRIFTED_STRATEGY
orchestration commoditizes; verification is defensible

rejected · DEAD END
build another agent command center

computed claim  ✓ matches artifact diff
```

The strategic change and rejection come from the actual Proofpress decision
history. “Match artifact” applies to computed changes and change claims, not the
stated why or unsigned actor attribution. Render real fixture output rather than
inventing an unavailable product UI.
### Beat 4 — the ledger crosses the handoff, 0:14–0:18

The ledger collapses into the artifact’s portable capsule and crosses into the
second session with the file. Session B opens it and recovers the edit, stated
why, rejected direction, and verification result.
On-screen copy:

```text
SHARED, CHECKABLE LEDGER
ATTACHED TO THE ARTIFACT
```
Show the consequence rather than another feature list:

```text
continue from v2
avoid the rejected approval workflow
```

This is the film’s proof moment: Session B acts differently because the ledger
traveled with the artifact.
### Beat 5 — vision bridge, 0:18–0:20
On-screen copy:

```text
GIT MADE CODE COLLABORATIVE.
PROOFPRESS MAKES INTELLIGENCE CUMULATIVE.
```

This is the bridge from the handoff wedge to the larger vision. It should be a
clean, readable hold rather than an extra product claim.
### Beat 6 — open-source close, 0:20–0:22
Final frame:

```text
PROOFPRESS

SCALE INTELLIGENCE.
PRESERVE TRUST.

OPEN SOURCE ON GITHUB
github.com/chenmingtang830/proofpress
```

Hold long enough to read the repository URL. Do not add an npm command, second
slogan, hashtag, or competing call to action.
## Frame plan

| Time | Frame | Evidence job | Motion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:03 | “Introducing Proofpress” + category | Name the product and market | Restrained title reveal |
| 0:03–0:07 | File crosses a handoff; decision trail stays behind | Establish the trust gap | File travels; rationale and lineage remain stranded |
| 0:07–0:11 | `v1 → v2`, edit and stated why | Reveal the ledger | Tight artifact/terminal crop |
| 0:11–0:14 | Rejection and matching change claims | Make “checkable” concrete | Rejection locks; check resolves |
| 0:14–0:18 | Ledger travels with the artifact; Session B continues | Prove portable continuity | Capsule folds into file, then reopens |
| 0:18–0:20 | Git → cumulative intelligence | Connect the wedge to the vision | Clean readable hold |
| 0:20–0:22 | Vision close and repository URL | Convert | Clean hold; no competing motion |
## Visual guardrails
- The artifact is always the stable center; agents and sessions rotate around
it.
- Use the ledger, capsule, and lineage as signals of admitted history, not as

claims of identity, authorization, access control, or cryptographic
  authorship.
- “Verified” modifies computed changes and change claims, never attributed why
or unsigned actors.
- Use one Canvas UI signature effect at most. HyperFrames owns all timing and
rendering.
- No old review UI, approval controls, thousand-line-diff hook, legacy install
command, or “Markdown gets its own Git” positioning.

- Terminal and artifact text must remain readable at ordinary X playback size.
- Do not show private repository names, local paths, real actor identifiers, or
internal strategy text beyond the approved launch fixture.
## Film acceptance test
After one silent viewing, an unfamiliar developer should be able to answer:

1. Why can Session B continue without Session A's conversation?
2. What makes the ledger more than ordinary edit history?
3. What travels with the artifact across the handoff?
4. Which parts are checked against the artifact, and which remain attributed context?

If the viewer answers only “it versions Markdown” or “it makes better diffs,”
the film has failed its strategic purpose.
## Video alt text

> A 22-second motion graphic introduces Proofpress as the trust layer for multiplayer AI—an open, agent-native ledger that travels with the artifact. A strategy document crosses from one human-agent workspace to another while its accepted rationale, rejected direction, and lineage remain stranded in the first session. Proofpress reveals a shared, checkable ledger of the edit, stated reason, rejection, and change-claim result; the ledger folds into the file and reopens in the next session. The film bridges to “Git made code collaborative. Proofpress makes intelligence cumulative.” and closes with “Scale intelligence. Preserve trust.” plus the open-source repository.
